promise: Resume joint military exercises (Exercise Angkor Sentinel) beginning February 2027
description: The Royal Cambodian Army announced on September 4, 2026, that Cambodia and the United States will resume joint military exercises in February 2027, the first such exercises since they were suspended in 2017. The exercise is codenamed Angkor Sentinel.
evidence: Royal Cambodian Army announcement of resumption in February 2027 (AP)
Cambodian and US militaries began detailed planning for the 2027 exercise (AKP)
